WITH linked_signals AS (
  SELECT 
    s.modindex,
    s.phaseshiftdeg,
    t.telescregistry,
    o.weathprofile
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
overall_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as baseline
  FROM linked_signals
),
telescope_weather_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    ls.telescregistry,
    ls.weathprofile,
    AVG(ls.modindex) as group_avg_modindex,
    AVG(ls.phaseshiftdeg) as group_avg_phaseshift
  FROM linked_signals ls
  GROUP BY ls.telescregistry, ls.weathprofile
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    twg.weathprofile,
    twg.group_avg_modindex,
    twg.group_avg_phaseshift,
    ob.baseline
  FROM telescope_weather_groups twg
  CROSS JOIN overall_baseline ob
  WHERE twg.group_avg_modindex > ob.baseline
)
SELECT 
  fg.weathprofile,
  AVG(fg.group_avg_modindex) as avg_modindex,
  AVG(fg.group_avg_phaseshift) as avg_phaseshift,
  AVG(fg.group_avg_modindex - fg.baseline) as avg_above_baseline
FROM filtered_groups fg
GROUP BY fg.weathprofile;

assumptions.assumption: Groups (telescope/weather combinations) are filtered based on whether their average modulation index exceeds the global baseline—computed once across all linked signals—not based on individual signal values exceeding the baseline.
